## Relación entre σ y IQR en la distribución normal
<div class="block-example fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="1">
  <div class="block-title">IQR de la Normal</div>
  <div class="block-body">
Para $X \sim N(\mu, \sigma^2)$:
$$IQR = Q_3 - Q_1 = \mu + 0.6745\sigma - (\mu - 0.6745\sigma) = 2 \times 0.6745\sigma \approx 1.35\sigma$$
  </div>
</div>

<div class="block-example fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="2">
  <div class="block-title">IQR de la Normal</div>
  <div class="block-body">
```{r}
# Verificación
sigma <- 1
IQR_norm <- diff(qnorm(c(0.25, 0.75)))
cat("IQR N(0,1) =", round(IQR_norm, 4), "\n")
cat("1.35*sigma =", round(1.35*sigma, 4), "\n")
```

  </div>
</div>
